fields.label: Shift Match Window Before (minutes)
fields.description: How many minutes before shift start to include punches

fields.label: Shift Match Window After (minutes)
fields.description: How many minutes after shift end to include punches

fields.label: Normal OT Rate (per hour)
fields.description: Placeholder rate until the Normal OT formula is configured. Editable per employee in the Payroll Worksheet.

fields.label: Double OT Rate (per hour)
fields.description: Placeholder rate until the Double OT formula is configured (holidays and weekly offs).

fields.label: Minimum OT Hours
fields.description: OT below this many hours (per OT type, per day) is not counted. 0 = count all.

fields.label: OT Punch Window After Shift End (minutes)
fields.description: OUT punches up to this many minutes after shift end still count (for overtime).

fields.label: Normal OT Salary Component
fields.description: Earning component used for the Normal OT Additional Salary created on Payroll Worksheet submit.

fields.label: Double OT Salary Component
fields.description: Earning component used for the Double OT Additional Salary created on Payroll Worksheet submit.

fields.label: Require API Key for Device Endpoints
fields.description: When enabled, biometric devices must provide the API key in the X-Device-Key header.

fields.label: Device API Key
fields.description: Shared secret for biometric devices. Generate a strong random string.

fields.label: Match Device User by Employee Number
fields.description: If a device user id has no explicit mapping, match it to the one Active employee of the device's branch whose Employee Number equals the id (and whose name contains the name on the device); the id is then saved on the Employee.

fields.label: Biometric Start Date
fields.description: Device records before this date are not stored (device_ingest returns skipped_old). The agent's min_punch_date should match.

fields.label: APIT Component
fields.description: Deduction SLHRM fills on every Salary Slip and worksheet row (slhrm.statutory.apply_apit). Empty = APIT off.

fields.label: APIT Slabs
fields.description: Progressive monthly bands. Taxable = all earnings (incl. OT, Other Allowance) - No Pay.

fields.label: Auto Create Payroll Entry on Worksheet Submit
